name: 继承（遗嘱/公证/遗产）分配

map.按遗产总额与法定继承人数估算人均份额、特留份下限与每人应继比例，辅助遗产分配。: Estimates the per-heir share, the compulsory-portion floor and each heir's percentage from the estate total and the number of statutory heirs, to support estate distribution.
map.📖 查看「继承（遗嘱/公证/遗产）分配 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Estate Distribution (Will / Notarisation / Inheritance) User Guide"
map.人均份额 = 总额 ÷ 人数；特留份下限 ≈ 总额 × 10%；每人应继占比 =: Per-heir share = total ÷ number of heirs; compulsory-portion floor ≈ total × 10%; each heir's percentage = 100% ÷ number of heirs
map.法定继承一般均分：人均份额=遗产总额÷继承人数，特留份（必留份额）下限约为总额1: Intestate succession is generally an equal split: per-heir share = estate total ÷ number of heirs, the compulsory portion floor is about 10% of the total to protect vulnerable heirs, and each heir's percentage = 100% ÷ number of heirs. A will may not go below the compulsory portion, or the affected part is void.
map.💡 人均份额 = 总额 ÷ 人数；特留份下限 ≈ 总额 × 10%；每人占比 =: 💡 Per-heir share = total ÷ number of heirs; compulsory-portion floor ≈ total × 10%; each heir's percentage = 100% ÷ number of heirs.
map.立遗嘱人按意愿分配遗产，工具辅助测算各继承人依遗嘱或法定应得份额。: A testator distributes the estate as wished, and the tool helps work out each heir's share under the will or by law.
map.办理继承公证前，先理清遗产范围与继承人清单。: Before notarising the succession, clarify the scope of the estate and the list of heirs.
map.对比遗嘱继承与法定继承的份额差异。: Compare the shares under testate and intestate succession.
map.遗产 500 万元，遗嘱指定配偶 300 万、子女 200 万，工具据此生成分配: An estate of ¥5,000,000 with ¥3,000,000 to the spouse and ¥2,000,000 to the children by will produces a distribution list; without a will it is split equally by law.
map.同一 500 万遗产，法定由 4 名第一顺序继承人各得 125 万；遗嘱可打破均: On the same ¥5,000,000 estate, four first-order heirs take ¥1,250,000 each by law; a will may depart from equality but must reserve a necessary share for heirs who lack earning capacity and have no source of income.
map.遗嘱一定要公证才有效吗？: Must a will be notarised to be valid?
map.不一定，自书、代书、打印、录音录像、口头（危急情况）遗嘱均可能有效，但公证遗嘱证: No. Holographic, dictated, printed, audio-visual and oral wills made in an emergency may all be valid, though a notarised will carries stronger evidential weight; an oral will lapses once the emergency ends.
map.哪些人必须保留份额？: Who must be left a share?
map.缺乏劳动能力又没有生活来源的继承人应保留必要遗产份额，该保留不受遗嘱其他安排削减: An heir who lacks earning capacity and has no source of income must be left a necessary share, which other provisions of the will cannot reduce.
map.继承（遗嘱/公证/遗产）分配。法律合规工具，基于现行法律法规计算，数据本地处理。: Estate Distribution (Will / Notarisation / Inheritance). A legal compliance tool that computes under current laws and regulations, with all data processed locally.
